name: VC Dimension / Projected No-Clashing Teaching Dimension (square-root)
details: For finite binary classes, $\mathrm{NCTD}^{p}(\mathcal H)=O(\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)^2)$; equivalently, VC dimension is at least a constant multiple of the square root of projected no-clashing teaching dimension.
proof: Every coordinate trace has VC dimension at most $\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)$. Apply the ordinary no-clashing quadratic bound to every trace and maximize over the trace, yielding $\mathrm{NCTD}^{p}(\mathcal H)\leq39.3752\,\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)^2-3.6330\,\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)$.
